name: nexus-exchange
description: Production-grade original multi-asset trading and exchange platform

scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace=@nexus/core && npm run build --workspace=@nexus/client && npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@nexus/server
scripts.db:deploy: node -e "if (process.env.DATABASE_URL) { try { require('child_process').execSync('prisma db push --schema packages/server/prisma/schema.prisma', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch(e) { console.warn('[DEPLOY] Prisma push warning:', e.message); } } else { console.log('[DEPLOY] No DATABASE_URL provided, skipping Prisma push'); }"
